notes: schema_validity_rate benchmark query set (EVALUATION_IMPLEMENTATION_TRACKER.md's 'do all 1-5' follow-up, 2026-08-12). Deliberately varied query shapes -- short/long, single-topic/comparative, narrow/open-ended -- since schema-invalid output tends to correlate with prompt shape (e.g. a very open-ended query producing more tasks than ResearchPlanningPolicy's budget, or the model padding a long rambling 'goal' field a strict schema rejects), not just topic.
